items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: he's playing with Lawrence Welk now

ctx.x: The second session was augmented. Had Vito Mussa, Allen Reuss, Archie Rosati -- he's playing with Lawrence Welk now -- had a girl singer named Frances Helen Hunt, I think. What was her name? The one that made the 'Big Apple' and 'You Can't Stop Me From Dreaming.' I don't know what else was left in the can, but we made more than that.
And with your first recording done with those major musicians, was that when you decided to --
